column1: # LegacyFolia settings catalog: one row per key of the eight TOML files under
# folia-server/src/main/resources/legacyfolia/ (worlds.toml holds overrides only, so it has none).
#   path        dotted TOML path, as ServerConfig and WorldConfig take it
#   per-world   true when [worlds.<name>] may override it
#   source      LegacySource of the key before this fork: SERVER_PROPERTIES, BUKKIT, SPIGOT,
#               SPIGOT_WORLD, COMMANDS, PAPER_GLOBAL, PAPER_WORLD, EULA_TXT, or NONE (the fork's own)
#   legacy-path exact path inside that file (spigot per-world keys under world-settings.default.,
#               paper per-world keys as in paper-world-defaults.yml)
#   also-from   further legacy locations of the same decision, source:path, separated by ;
#   vanilla     name in server.properties when it is a vanilla key
#   mutable     true when the running server writes it back (a vanilla MutableValue: /difficulty,
#   secret      true when the key names a secret file; never written to server.properties
#   values      allowed values of an ENUM, comma separated
#   default     the TOML default, written as a TOML value
#   notes       fallbacks, conversions, and anything a reader or the migration must know
# Keep it in the order of the TOML files. SettingsCatalogTest fails when a key is added to a TOML file
# without a row here, or a row names a key that no file has, or the defaults disagree.
